_readme: Allowlist of private repos surfaced in Exhibit 4's 'Private Work' section. A repo shows up here — named, with real commit dates/SHAs/subject lines run through the SAME category rubric + sanitize_message() as public rows, never a diff or full file content — only after being explicitly classified. Only repos with NO existing public mirror belong here; a repo already covered by a public-preview export stays out to avoid double-counting the same work in two sections. New repos default to unlisted/excluded until reviewed; see privatewitness_scan.py --scan.

mystarch.note: Augment Intent chief-of-staff coordination workspace; private-forever by design, no public mirror. This path is a git worktree of the same repo Christopher originally pointed to (~/intent/workspaces/__chief__) — using the worktree checkout as the single canonical path to avoid double-registering the same history under two ids.

trading-bot-arbitrage.note: Private DEX-arbitrage bot (DAPPUv3, Hardhat, UNI-CAKE). No public mirror found. Christopher flagged: this repo will eventually connect a real funded web3 wallet -- sanitize_message() was hardened (0x-hex + base58 key redaction) specifically ahead of that, since commit messages here are read and shown (sanitized) in Exhibit 4.
